an appointment here is a nightmare! It’s same-day only, so you have to call at exactly 8am, but everyone else is doing the same thing and the lines are instantly jammed. By the time you get through, there’s no appointments left. I currently have a lump I’m worried about and when I spoke to a receptionist I was told that to get an appointment I either had to queue outside the practice from 8am or use the eConsult online form. Queuing at 8am, is not at all a realistic option, I have a job, and I cannot drop everything on the off-chance I might be lucky enough to secure a slot before everyone else. Also, if you are ill with a flu or chest infection for example, can you imagine having to queue out in the cold when you feel terrible? Ridiculous.

I went ahead and submitted an eConsult two days ago for the lump. Still no response. For something like that, you’d expect a bit of urgency, no? The eConsult is also supposed to be quick and easy but really isn’t. I once submitted one for a sore throat I’d had for over a month and was told to go to a pharmacist. I knew immediately that they wouldn’t be able to help but went anyway, and was told to see a GP. I then had to call back, having wasted a whole afternoon, and somehow got a same-day appointment the moment I complained. Why couldn’t that have happened the first time? It really felt like whoever read my econsult form hadn’t actually read it properly.

The whole system makes you not want to bother seeking help at all, which is a terrible place to be with your own healthcare. The receptionists are lovely and this definitely isn’t on them, but something needs to change.
